# Quote the trip, not just the stamp.

> Price a mobile notary appointment from mileage, drive time, print pages, witnesses and waiting — then test a signing service's flat offer against what you actually earn per hour after paper, toner and fuel.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
